:::{#thm-pos-agreement-harmonic}
#### Positive agreement is a harmonic mean

For an agreement table with $a > 0$,
the positive agreement (@def-positive-agreement)
is the harmonic mean (@def-harmonic-mean)
of the estimated positive predictive value and sensitivity
(@def-agreement-test-measures):

$$
p_{\text{pos}} = H\paren{\Est{\text{PPV}}, \Est{\text{sensitivity}}}
$$ {#eq-pos-agreement-harmonic}

:::

::: proof

By @exr-pos-agreement-harmonic,
the harmonic mean equals $2a / (2a + b + c)$,
which is $p_{\text{pos}}$ by @def-positive-agreement.

:::
